harnessContract.tree: div.row > div.rowText > div.title + div.desc[role=alert only on error]; PresetMenu(portal=true, align=end) > button.selector[aria-haspopup=menu][aria-expanded] > current label + chevron
harnessContract.labelRule: menu labels are strings; a user-trust option renders '<name> · <userTrust>'
harnessContract.stateOwner: the settings surface owns roster/currentValue/writable/status/error and closes the menu after selection
harnessContract.dispose: the owner retracts the body portal/listeners and restores the host DOM

vcpCandidate.productionConsumer: none; VCP has no equivalent non-frozen preset preference business capability
